224	class TanhSequence:
225	    def __init__(self, linear):
226	        # A Linear with at least two weights: the first d = len(weight) - 1
227	        # weights are the input-feature coefficients, the last weight is the
228	        # recurrent hidden-state coefficient, and the Linear bias is reused.
229	        # Rejected immediately, without touching the passed layer's
230	        # parameters, gradients, or last-forward record.
231	        if not isinstance(linear, Linear):
232	            raise ValueError("TanhSequence requires a Linear with at least two weights")
233	        if len(linear.weight) < 2:
234	            raise ValueError("TanhSequence requires a Linear with at least two weights")
235	        self.linear = linear
236	        # Number of input features per row. d == 1 keeps the original scalar
237	        # sequence behavior (flat gradient lists); d > 1 switches the
238	        # backward entries to nested per-feature rows.
239	        self.d = len(linear.weight) - 1
240	        self.hidden = 0.0
241	        self.outputs = []
242	        self._fwd = None
243	        # Active stream session record, or None when no session is open.
244	        self._stream = None
245	
246	    def reset(self):
247	        self.hidden = 0.0
248	        self.outputs = []
249	        # Resetting invalidates any cached sequence forward pass, but leaves
250	        # the wrapped Linear's parameters, accumulated gradients, and its own
251	        # last-forward record completely untouched.
252	        self._fwd = None
253	        # Any half-finished stream session is abandoned as well.
254	        self._stream = None
255	
256	    def checkpoint(self):
257	        # Captures the full state required to resume computation later and
258	        # returns it as a checkpoint that belongs to this instance only. The
259	        # call never mutates any state and may be made on a fresh object, after
260	        # reset(), right after a batch forward, or in the middle of a stream
261	        # session. Every mutable datum is deep-copied, so the checkpoint shares
262	        # no reference with live state and survives parameter updates,
263	        # zero_grad()/reset(), and continued stepping; the same checkpoint can
264	        # be restored any number of times.
265	        fwd = self._fwd
266	        if fwd is None:
267	            fwd_copy = None
268	        else:
269	            fwd_copy = {
270	                "inputs": [list(row) for row in fwd["inputs"]],
271	                "prev_hiddens": list(fwd["prev_hiddens"]),
272	                "outputs": list(fwd["outputs"]),
273	                "boundaries": set(fwd["boundaries"]),
274	                "truncate": fwd["truncate"],
275	                "carry_hidden": fwd["carry_hidden"],
276	                "weights": list(fwd["weights"]),
277	            }
278	        stream = self._stream
279	        if stream is None:
280	            stream_copy = None
281	        else:
282	            stream_copy = {
283	                "inputs": [list(row) for row in stream["inputs"]],
284	                "prev_hiddens": list(stream["prev_hiddens"]),
285	                "outputs": list(stream["outputs"]),
286	                "boundaries": set(stream["boundaries"]),
287	                "truncate": stream["truncate"],
288	                "carry_hidden": stream["carry_hidden"],
289	                "initial_hidden": stream["initial_hidden"],
290	                "weights": list(stream["weights"]),
291	            }
292	        return _Checkpoint(
293	            owner_ref=weakref.ref(self),
294	            width=self.d + 1,
295	            hidden=self.hidden,
296	            outputs=list(self.outputs),
297	            fwd=fwd_copy,
298	            stream=stream_copy,
299	            linear_weight=list(self.linear.weight),
300	            linear_bias=self.linear.bias,
301	            linear_grad=list(self.linear.grad),
302	            linear_grad_bias=self.linear.grad_bias,
303	            linear_last=None if self.linear.last is None
304	            else list(self.linear.last),
305	            linear_last_weight=None if self.linear._last_weight is None
306	            else list(self.linear._last_weight),
307	        )
308	
309	    def restore(self, checkpoint):
310	        # Validate first, then commit atomically: a rejected checkpoint must
311	        # leave hidden state, outputs, any open stream session, the Linear's
312	        # parameters/gradients and its forward cache exactly as they were.
313	        # A checkpoint from another TanhSequence instance (even one wrapping
314	        # an equal-valued Linear) or one whose weight width disagrees with the
315	        # current Linear is rejected, as is any structurally corrupted one.
316	        if not isinstance(checkpoint, _Checkpoint):
317	            raise ValueError("restore requires a checkpoint returned by checkpoint()")
318	
319	        def fail():
320	            raise ValueError("checkpoint is corrupted")
321	
322	        def _validate():
323	            owner = checkpoint._owner_ref()
324	            if owner is not self:
325	                raise ValueError(
326	                    "checkpoint belongs to a different TanhSequence instance")
327	            if not isinstance(checkpoint._width, int) \
328	                    or isinstance(checkpoint._width, bool) or checkpoint._width < 2:
329	                fail()
330	            if checkpoint._width != len(self.linear.weight):
331	                raise ValueError(
332	                    "checkpoint width %d is incompatible with the current "
333	                    "Linear width %d"
334	                    % (checkpoint._width, len(self.linear.weight)))
335	
336	            # A scalar is any non-bool int/float; it must also lie in the
337	            # finite numeric domain (no NaN, infinities or overflow-sized
338	            # ints), otherwise restoring it could poison later arithmetic.
339	            def need_number(value):
340	                if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
341	                    fail()
342	                if not _is_finite(value):
343	                    raise ValueError("checkpoint contains a non-finite numeric value")
344	
345	            def need_number_list(value, length=None):
346	                if not isinstance(value, list):
347	                    fail()
348	                if length is not None and len(value) != length:
349	                    fail()
350	                for item in value:
351	                    need_number(item)
352	
353	            width = checkpoint._width
354	            need_number(checkpoint._hidden)
355	            need_number_list(checkpoint._outputs)
356	            need_number_list(checkpoint._linear_weight, width)
357	            need_number(checkpoint._linear_bias)
358	            need_number_list(checkpoint._linear_grad, width)
359	            need_number(checkpoint._linear_grad_bias)
360	            if checkpoint._linear_last is None:
361	                if checkpoint._linear_last_weight is not None:
362	                    fail()
363	            else:
364	                need_number_list(checkpoint._linear_last, width)
365	                if checkpoint._linear_last_weight is None:
366	                    fail()
367	                need_number_list(checkpoint._linear_last_weight, width)
368	
369	            def validate_trajectory(record, extra_keys, expect_initial=False):
370	                # Structural validation first: exact key set, scalar/list
371	                # types, finite numeric domain, equal per-step lengths and
372	                # boundary indices inside the valid range.
373	                if record is None:
374	                    return
375	                if not isinstance(record, dict):
376	                    fail()
377	                keys = {"inputs", "prev_hiddens", "outputs", "boundaries",
378	                        "truncate", "carry_hidden", "weights"} | extra_keys
379	                if set(record.keys()) != keys:
380	                    fail()
381	                truncate = record["truncate"]
382	                if truncate is not None:
383	                    if (isinstance(truncate, bool)
384	                            or not isinstance(truncate, int) or truncate <= 0):
385	                        fail()
386	                if not isinstance(record["carry_hidden"], bool):
387	                    fail()
388	                need_number_list(record["weights"], width)
389	                n = len(record["outputs"])
390	                if (len(record["inputs"]) != n
391	                        or len(record["prev_hiddens"]) != n):
392	                    fail()
393	                need_number_list(record["outputs"])
394	                need_number_list(record["prev_hiddens"])
395	                if not isinstance(record["inputs"], list):
396	                    fail()
397	                for row in record["inputs"]:
398	                    need_number_list(row, width - 1)
399	                if not isinstance(record["boundaries"], set):
400	                    fail()
401	                for index in record["boundaries"]:
402	                    if not isinstance(index, int) or isinstance(index, bool) \
403	                            or not 0 <= index < n:
404	                        fail()
405	                # Open-stream records alone remember the session's starting
406	                # hidden state; read it only once the exact key set above has
407	                # been confirmed.
408	                initial_hidden = None
409	                if expect_initial:
410	                    initial_hidden = record["initial_hidden"]
411	                    need_number(initial_hidden)
412	                # Semantic validation: the arrays must describe one and the
413	                # same traversal. Every period the truncate rule cuts must be
414	                # present in the boundary set (explicit starts may add more),
415	                # and each prev_hiddens entry must be the value that step
416	                # actually consumed: a stream's first step consumes its
417	                # initial_hidden; a nonzero boundary consumes the previous
418	                # segment's last output when carrying, else exactly zero;
419	                # every other step continues from the previous output.
420	                boundaries = record["boundaries"]
421	                if truncate is not None:
422	                    for index in range(n):
423	                        if index % truncate == 0 and index not in boundaries:
424	                            fail()
425	                outputs = record["outputs"]
426	                prev_hiddens = record["prev_hiddens"]
427	                carry = record["carry_hidden"]
428	                for t in range(n):
429	                    if t == 0:
430	                        # Only open-stream records remember the session's
431	                        # initial_hidden; a committed batch record has no
432	                        # stored starting value to compare step 0 against.
433	                        if initial_hidden is not None \
434	                                and prev_hiddens[0] != initial_hidden:
435	                            fail()
436	                    elif t in boundaries:
437	                        expected = outputs[t - 1] if carry else 0.0
438	                        if prev_hiddens[t] != expected:
439	                            fail()
440	                    elif prev_hiddens[t] != outputs[t - 1]:
441	                        fail()
442	
443	            # The committed batch pass and an open stream session are mutually
444	            # exclusive in live state, so a checkpoint carrying both could
445	            # never have been produced and is rejected outright.
446	            fwd_record = checkpoint._fwd
447	            stream = checkpoint._stream
448	            if fwd_record is not None and stream is not None:
449	                fail()
450	
451	            # The committed batch pass. Its outputs must equal the visible
452	            # outputs captured at checkpoint time.
453	            if fwd_record is not None:
454	                validate_trajectory(fwd_record, set())
455	                if fwd_record["outputs"] != checkpoint._outputs:
456	                    fail()
457	
458	            # The open stream session (None when no session was active).
459	            if stream is not None:
460	                validate_trajectory(stream, {"initial_hidden"},
461	                                    expect_initial=True)
462	                # An open session is always reflected in the visible outputs.
463	                if stream["outputs"] != checkpoint._outputs:
464	                    fail()
465	
466	            # The public hidden state must agree with the visible trajectory:
467	            # it is the last produced output whenever one exists; an empty open
468	            # session still sits exactly at its initial_hidden. With no
469	            # trajectory and no open session the finite-domain check above is
470	            # all the hidden slot can be judged against.
471	            if checkpoint._outputs:
472	                if checkpoint._hidden != checkpoint._outputs[-1]:
473	                    fail()
474	            elif stream is not None:
475	                if checkpoint._hidden != stream["initial_hidden"]:
476	                    fail()
477	
478	        # All validation happens before any state is touched, so a rejected
479	        # checkpoint (including one with deleted/replaced attributes) always
480	        # raises ValueError and leaves the instance completely unchanged.
481	        try:
482	            _validate()
483	        except ValueError:
484	            raise

534	        # state, but as an independent plain-data object (only dicts, lists,

579	    def import_state(self, state):
580	        # Validate completely, then commit atomically. Structural validation
581	        # (plain-data types, exact field sets, version and kind) happens here;
582	        # the parsed state is then turned into a checkpoint owned by this
583	        # instance and funneled through restore(), which re-validates every
584	        # semantic rule (finite numeric domain, width compatibility,
585	        # trajectory/boundary consistency, the truncation hidden-state rules,
586	        # batch-cache/stream exclusivity, Linear cache shapes) before
587	        # committing, so any rejected state raises ValueError and leaves the
588	        # sequence state, the Linear's parameters, its cache and its
589	        # gradients exactly as they were. The input object is never mutated,
590	        # the committed state shares no reference with it, and importing the
591	        # same object repeatedly yields the same result.
592	        checkpoint = self._parse_exported_state(state)
593	        return self.restore(checkpoint)

595	    def _parse_exported_state(self, state):
596	        # Structural validation of a plain-data state object and conversion
597	        # into a _Checkpoint owned by this instance. Only the boundary lists
598	        # are converted (to the sets restore() expects); every other value is
599	        # passed through for restore()'s semantic validation.
600	        def fail():
601	            raise ValueError("state has an invalid structure")
602	
603	        if not isinstance(state, dict):
604	            raise ValueError(
605	                "import_state requires a state produced by export_state()")
606	        if set(state.keys()) != {"version", "kind", "width", "hidden",
607	                                 "outputs", "forward", "stream", "linear"}:
608	            fail()
609	        version = state["version"]
610	        if isinstance(version, bool) or not isinstance(version, int):
611	            fail()
612	        if version != _STATE_VERSION:
613	            raise ValueError("unsupported state version %r" % (version,))
614	        if state["kind"] != _STATE_KIND:
615	            fail()
616	        width = state["width"]
617	        if isinstance(width, bool) or not isinstance(width, int) or width < 2:
618	            fail()
619	        linear = state["linear"]
620	        if not isinstance(linear, dict) \
621	                or set(linear.keys()) != {"weight", "bias", "grad",
622	                                          "grad_bias", "last", "last_weight"}:
623	            fail()
624	
625	        def parse_trajectory(record, expect_initial):
626	            if record is None:
627	                return None
628	            if not isinstance(record, dict):
629	                fail()
630	            keys = {"inputs", "prev_hiddens", "outputs", "boundaries",
631	                    "truncate", "carry_hidden", "weights"}
632	            if expect_initial:
633	                keys = keys | {"initial_hidden"}
634	            if set(record.keys()) != keys:
635	                fail()
636	            boundaries = record["boundaries"]
637	            if not isinstance(boundaries, list):
638	                fail()
639	            for index in boundaries:
640	                if isinstance(index, bool) or not isinstance(index, int):
641	                    fail()
642	            # Shallow copy so the caller's dict is never mutated; restore()
643	            # deep-copies everything it commits, so no reference to the
644	            # input object can reach the live state.
645	            parsed = dict(record)
646	            parsed["boundaries"] = set(boundaries)
647	            return parsed
648	
649	        return _Checkpoint(
650	            owner_ref=weakref.ref(self),
651	            width=width,
652	            hidden=state["hidden"],
653	            outputs=state["outputs"],
654	            fwd=parse_trajectory(state["forward"], False),
655	            stream=parse_trajectory(state["stream"], True),
656	            linear_weight=linear["weight"],
657	            linear_bias=linear["bias"],
658	            linear_grad=linear["grad"],
659	            linear_grad_bias=linear["grad_bias"],
660	            linear_last=linear["last"],
661	            linear_last_weight=linear["last_weight"],
662	        )

664	    def step(self, row, segment_start=False):
665	        # Validate before any state is touched, so a rejected row changes
666	        # neither hidden/outputs nor the Linear's last-forward record, and a
667	        # batch forward cache stays available for backward().
668	        if not isinstance(segment_start, bool):
669	            raise ValueError("segment_start must be a boolean")
670	        values = _read_row(row, self.d)
671	        stream = self._stream
672	        if stream is not None:
673	            return self._stream_step(stream, values, segment_start)
674	        if segment_start:
675	            # Explicit boundary marks are only meaningful inside a session;
676	            # outside one there is no recorded trajectory to cut.
677	            raise RuntimeError(
678	                "segment_start=True requires an active stream session; "
679	                "call start_stream first")
680	        # Compute into a local first; only commit once the Linear forward and
681	        # the tanh succeeded.
682	        new_hidden = math.tanh(self.linear.forward(values + [self.hidden]))
683	        self.hidden = new_hidden
684	        self.outputs.append(new_hidden)
685	        # Continuing the trajectory stepwise mixes it with any recorded batch
686	        # pass, so that cache can no longer be back-propagated safely.
687	        self._fwd = None
688	        return new_hidden

690	    def _stream_step(self, stream, values, segment_start):
691	        # One step inside an active stream session. The row and the boundary
692	        # flag are already validated; the step follows the same segment-
693	        # boundary rules as the batch traversal so the recorded trajectory
694	        # back-propagates with the shared formulas once finish_stream commits
695	        # it.
696	        i = len(stream["inputs"])
697	        truncate = stream["truncate"]
698	        truncate_boundary = truncate is not None and i % truncate == 0
699	        if truncate_boundary or segment_start:
700	            # Segment start. The first segment starts from the session's
701	            # initial hidden state; without carry every later segment resets
702	            # to zero; with carry it starts from a numeric copy of the
703	            # previous segment's last hidden value. That copy is detached: it
704	            # enters this step's local derivatives but no gradient crosses
705	            # back over the boundary. Explicit segment_start marks merge with
706	            # the truncate-produced boundaries.
707	            if i == 0:
708	                hidden = stream["initial_hidden"]
709	            elif stream["carry_hidden"]:
710	                hidden = float(stream["outputs"][-1])
711	            else:
712	                hidden = 0.0
713	            stream["boundaries"].add(i)
714	        else:
715	            hidden = self.hidden
716	        new_hidden = math.tanh(self.linear.forward(values + [hidden]))
717	        self.hidden = new_hidden
718	        self.outputs.append(new_hidden)
719	        stream["inputs"].append(values)
720	        stream["prev_hiddens"].append(hidden)
721	        stream["outputs"].append(new_hidden)
722	        return new_hidden

724	    def start_stream(self, initial_hidden=None, truncate=None, carry_hidden=False):
725	        # Same validation rules as the batch forward, applied before any
726	        # state, cache, or Linear record is touched, so a rejected argument
727	        # changes nothing.
728	        if truncate is not None:
729	            if isinstance(truncate, bool) or not isinstance(truncate, int) or truncate <= 0:
730	                raise ValueError("truncate must be a positive integer or None")
731	        if not isinstance(carry_hidden, bool):
732	            raise ValueError("carry_hidden must be a boolean")
733	        if initial_hidden is None:
734	            initial_hidden = 0.0
735	        else:
736	            initial_hidden = _read_number(initial_hidden, "initial_hidden")
737	        if self._stream is not None:
738	            raise RuntimeError(
739	                "a stream session is already active; call finish_stream first")

741	        # cache and starts a fresh output trajectory from the given initial
742	        # hidden state. The Linear's parameters, accumulated gradients, and
743	        # last-forward record are left untouched.
744	        self.hidden = initial_hidden
745	        self.outputs = []
746	        self._fwd = None
747	        self._stream = {
748	            "inputs": [],
749	            "prev_hiddens": [],
750	            "outputs": [],
751	            "boundaries": set(),
752	            "truncate": truncate,
753	            "carry_hidden": carry_hidden,
754	            "initial_hidden": initial_hidden,
755	            # Parameter state as of the session's forward traversal; a later
756	            # apply_gradients() must not affect backward() of this session.

764	            raise RuntimeError(

774	            "truncate": stream["truncate"],
775	            "carry_hidden": stream["carry_hidden"],

781	    def forward(self, rows, truncate=None, carry_hidden=False, initial_hidden=None,
782	                segment_starts=None):
783	        if truncate is not None:
784	            if isinstance(truncate, bool) or not isinstance(truncate, int) or truncate <= 0:
785	                raise ValueError("truncate must be a positive integer or None")
786	        # Only an actual boolean is accepted (bool is a subclass of int, so an
787	        # explicit isinstance check is required). Validated before any state,
788	        # cache, or Linear forward record is touched.
789	        if not isinstance(carry_hidden, bool):
790	            raise ValueError("carry_hidden must be a boolean")
791	        # Optional external starting hidden state for this call. Omitted
792	        # (None) keeps the existing rule of starting from 0.0. Validated with
793	        # the same scalar rules as every other numeric argument, before any
794	        # state, cache, or Linear forward record is touched, so a rejected
795	        # value changes nothing.
796	        if initial_hidden is None:
797	            initial_hidden = 0.0
798	        else:
799	            initial_hidden = _read_number(initial_hidden, "initial_hidden")
800	        # Optional per-row boundary declarations, read in input-row order.
801	        # None keeps the existing behavior; otherwise one bool per row is
802	        # required, validated (type and length) before any state is touched.
803	        if segment_starts is not None:
804	            segment_flags = _read_bool_sequence(segment_starts, "segment_starts")
805	            try:
806	                n_rows = len(rows)
807	            except TypeError:
808	                raise ValueError(
809	                    "segment_starts requires a sized rows sequence")
810	            if len(segment_flags) != n_rows:
811	                raise ValueError(
812	                    "segment_starts length %d does not match rows length %d"
813	                    % (len(segment_flags), n_rows))
814	        else:
815	            segment_flags = None
816	
817	        # Validate every input row (type, width and finite domain) up front,
818	        # before any state, cache or Linear forward record is touched, so a
819	        # batch containing a bad row anywhere can never leave a partial
820	        # trajectory.
821	        validated_rows = [_read_row(row, self.d) for row in rows]
822	
823	        # Snapshot every piece of observable state the traversal may touch so
824	        # that any failure rolls the sequence back to its pre-call state: a
825	        # rejected traversal must leave neither a half-advanced hidden state
826	        # nor a partial Linear forward record, and must leave any earlier
827	        # successful forward cache available for backward().
828	        saved_hidden = self.hidden
829	        saved_outputs = self.outputs
830	        saved_fwd = self._fwd
831	        saved_stream = self._stream
832	        saved_last = self.linear.last
833	        saved_last_weight = self.linear._last_weight
834	        saved_grad = list(self.linear.grad)
835	        saved_grad_bias = self.linear.grad_bias
836	
837	        inputs = []
838	        prev_hiddens = []
839	        outputs = []
840	        boundaries = set()
841	        # Parameter state of this forward pass. A later apply_gradients()
842	        # must not affect backward() of the recorded pass.
843	        weights = list(self.linear.weight)
844	
845	        # The traversal works on locals only; self.* is committed solely on
846	        # full success below. An empty rows sequence therefore commits
847	        # initial_hidden as the current hidden state with empty outputs.
848	        hidden = initial_hidden
849	        try:
850	            for i, x in enumerate(validated_rows):
851	                declared = segment_flags is not None and segment_flags[i]
852	                if (truncate is not None and i % truncate == 0) or declared:
853	                    # Segment start. The very first segment starts from
854	                    # initial_hidden; without carry every later segment is
855	                    # reset to zero; with carry every later segment starts
856	                    # from a numeric copy of the previous segment's last
857	                    # hidden value. The value is detached from the autograd
858	                    # graph: it enters the local derivatives of this
859	                    # segment's first step but no gradient crosses back.
860	                    # Explicit segment_starts declarations merge with the
861	                    # truncate-produced boundaries; a mark at position 0 only
862	                    # confirms the initial boundary.
863	                    if i > 0 and carry_hidden:
864	                        hidden = outputs[-1]
865	                    elif i > 0:
866	                        hidden = 0.0
867	                    else:
868	                        hidden = initial_hidden
869	                    boundaries.add(i)
870	                prev_hiddens.append(hidden)

872	                # caching anything, and math.tanh of a finite value is always
873	                # finite, so every committed hidden/output value is finite.
874	                hidden = math.tanh(self.linear.forward(x + [hidden]))
875	                inputs.append(x)
876	                outputs.append(hidden)
877	        except (TypeError, ValueError):
878	            self.hidden = saved_hidden
879	            self.outputs = saved_outputs
880	            self._fwd = saved_fwd
881	            self._stream = saved_stream
882	            self.linear.last = saved_last
883	            self.linear._last_weight = saved_last_weight
884	            self.linear.grad = saved_grad
885	            self.linear.grad_bias = saved_grad_bias

888	        self.hidden = hidden
889	        # Each consumer gets its own list: the public outputs field, the
890	        # backward cache and the value returned to the caller are independent
891	        # copies, so assigning, appending, deleting or clearing elements of the
892	        # returned list (or of seq.outputs) can never reach the cached
893	        # trajectory used by backward(), checkpoint() or export_state(). The
894	        # elements themselves are immutable numbers, so a shallow copy fully
895	        # detaches the lists. Two successive calls likewise never share a
896	        # returned object.
897	        self.outputs = list(outputs)
898	        # A successful batch traversal supersedes any half-finished stream

900	        self._stream = None
901	        # Cache of this forward pass for backward(). Only committed once the
902	        # whole traversal succeeded, so an illegal row leaves any earlier
903	        # successful record intact.
904	        self._fwd = {
905	            "inputs": inputs,
906	            "prev_hiddens": prev_hiddens,
907	            "outputs": list(outputs),
908	            "boundaries": boundaries,
909	            "truncate": truncate,
910	            "carry_hidden": carry_hidden,
911	            "weights": weights,
912	        }
913	        return list(outputs)

915	    def backward(self, grad_outputs):
916	        # Terminal hidden-state gradient is zero, so this is exactly the
917	        # previously recorded behavior: only the per-input gradient list is
918	        # returned (parameter gradients are accumulated on the Linear).
919	        return self._backward(grad_outputs, 0.0, return_initial=False)

921	    def backward_with_initial_hidden(self, grad_outputs, grad_hidden=0.0):

923	        # gradient of the cached forward's final hidden state and returns the
924	        # gradient with respect to that forward's initial_hidden as well.
925	        return self._backward(grad_outputs, grad_hidden, return_initial=True)

927	    def backward_with_boundaries(self, grad_outputs, grad_hidden=0.0):
928	        # Like backward_with_initial_hidden(), but additionally reports the
929	        # hidden-state gradient arriving at every segment start past index 0.
930	        # The third return value is a list of (index, gradient) pairs in
931	        # ascending index order, built from the cached pass's merged boundary
932	        # set (truncate-produced and explicitly declared starts, deduplicated).
933	        # Each gradient is taken with respect to the detached boundary
934	        # constant consumed at that start: the numeric copy of the previous
935	        # segment's final hidden value when carry_hidden was true, the zero
936	        # constant otherwise. Index 0 is not listed; its gradient is the
937	        # returned grad_initial_hidden. With no nonzero boundaries (or an
938	        # empty cached sequence) the list is empty.
939	        return self._backward(grad_outputs, grad_hidden, return_initial=True,
940	                              return_boundaries=True)

942	    def _backward(self, grad_outputs, grad_hidden, return_initial,
943	                  return_boundaries=False):
944	        if self._stream is not None:
945	            raise RuntimeError(
946	                "backward requires the stream session to be finished first")
947	        if self._fwd is None:
948	            raise RuntimeError("backward requires a cached forward pass; call forward first")
949	
950	        inputs = self._fwd["inputs"]
951	        prev_hiddens = self._fwd["prev_hiddens"]
952	        outputs = self._fwd["outputs"]
953	        boundaries = self._fwd["boundaries"]
954	        # Forward-time parameter snapshot: the first d weights pair with the
955	        # d input features of each recorded row, the last with the previous
956	        # hidden state.
957	        weights = self._fwd["weights"]
958	        d = len(weights) - 1
959	        w_inputs = weights[:d]
960	        w_hidden = weights[d]
961	        n = len(outputs)
962	        # Validate every argument before any gradient is accumulated, so a
963	        # rejected call leaves both the cache and the Linear's accumulated
964	        # gradients exactly as they were.
965	        grad_outputs = _read_grad_list(grad_outputs, n)
966	        grad_hidden = _read_number(grad_hidden, "grad_hidden")
967	
968	        # Accumulate this pass entirely into locals and commit to the Linear
969	        # only once every produced value is finite, so an overflowing pass
970	        # never leaves partially accumulated parameter gradients.
971	        param_grad = list(self.linear.grad)
972	        param_grad_bias = self.linear.grad_bias
973	
974	        input_grads = [0.0] * n
975	        # Hidden-state gradients recorded at segment starts past index 0, in
976	        # traversal (descending) order; reversed into ascending order below.
977	        boundary_grads = []
978	
979	        # The terminal hidden-state gradient seeds the recurrence at the last
980	        # step, where it is added to that step's output gradient. A zero seed
981	        # reproduces backward() bit for bit.
982	        hidden_grad = float(grad_hidden)
983	        # An empty cached sequence has no steps: return the terminal gradient
984	        # unchanged (as provided) without touching any parameter gradient.
985	        grad_initial_hidden = grad_hidden if n == 0 else 0.0
986	        try:
987	            for t in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
988	                # Gradient from later steps *within this segment* (including the
989	                # terminal hidden-state gradient at the final step) still flows
990	                # into the current step together with its own output gradient.
991	                dh = grad_outputs[t] + hidden_grad
992	                d_pre = dh * (1.0 - outputs[t] * outputs[t])  # tanh derivative
993	
994	                # Parameter gradients at this step are always accumulated,
995	                # including at segment starts (the detached carry value is
996	                # treated as a constant and enters this local derivative only).
997	                row = inputs[t]
998	                for k in range(d):
999	                    param_grad[k] += d_pre * row[k]
1000	                param_grad[d] += d_pre * prev_hiddens[t]
1001	                param_grad_bias += d_pre
1002	
1003	                # Input gradients mirror the input shape: one row of d gradients
1004	                # per step for a multi-feature sequence, and the original flat
1005	                # scalar list when d == 1.
1006	                row_grads = [d_pre * w for w in w_inputs]
1007	                input_grads[t] = row_grads[0] if d == 1 else row_grads
1008	                # Step 0 always consumes initial_hidden as its previous hidden
1009	                # state. With truncation the boundary cut below severs later
1010	                # segments, so this local term is the full gradient with respect
1011	                # to initial_hidden; without truncation it is reached uncut.
1012	                if t == 0:
1013	                    grad_initial_hidden = d_pre * w_hidden
1014	                if t in boundaries:
1015	                    # Truncated BPTT: segment-start hidden values (zeroed or
1016	                    # carried as detached numbers) are constants, so no gradient
1017	                    # crosses back into the prior segment. For a start past
1018	                    # index 0, d_pre * w_hidden is the total gradient the merged
1019	                    # within-segment recurrence delivers to that detached
1020	                    # boundary constant; record it before severing the link.
